RGC Asia presents

Asia Pub: Game Night

Every month, the Asia Public channel turns up the heat. Play your games, climb the stats, and make your name stand out.

Monthly Warcraft III Dota 1 Community Event

⚔️ How It Works

1
Join the action

Play during the official Asia Pub: Game Night event period.

2
Make your stats count

Your performance during the event is what puts you in contention for the top spots.

3
Watch the leaderboard

The three highest-ranked players in the event stats will be recognized as the top performers and receive the announced rewards.

4
Claim your reward

The top 3 players will receive the rewards listed below. Both Global Rank — Asia NightStar and Diamond Membership rewards are valid for 2 months.

📅 When Is It?

Every month. The official date and time for the next Asia Pub: Game Night will be announced in the RGC Asia Public channel.

Keep an eye on the Asia Public channel. The next Asia Pub: Game Night can be announced at any time.

🤖 SG Bot Channel Notice

Please take note: This is an SG Bot Channel. Event-related statistics and standings are based on the information recorded through the channel's SG Bot system. Please make sure you are in the Asia Public channel and follow the bot's instructions when participating.

🌏 Who Can Join?

Players from across the RGC Asia community are welcome to participate. Players from different countries can compete in the same event.

Event recognition and rewards will follow the official Asia Pub: Game Night rules announced for each edition.
